    The periodic gauge on a star model (Lemma A.1(1)) #

    lem:periodic-scalar-gauges (1), periodic-mesh-calculations.tex, for Q = ℤΔ / ⟨g⟩ with Δ a star rooted at its centre, g (v, t) = (σ v, t + c₀) and σ fixing the centre and permuting the arms by θ.

    The coefficients are recorded by Cf w w' h, the coefficient at (w, h + 2) of the arrow from (w', h + 1), invariant under g. The unknowns are the arrow scales M e h (the arrow over the edge with child endpoint e at source height h) and the relation scales N v h. On the representative arm of each θ-orbit the edges are treated down the arm (reps): the parent's relation scales are known, and exists_periodic_line_vertex gives the arrow scales and the child's relation scales, with period per · c₀. The other arms of the orbit are obtained by applying g.
